NSHDLH

Nearshore Marine Forecast
National Weather Service Duluth MN
211 PM CDT Sat Oct 10 2026

For waters within five nautical miles of shore on Lake Superior.         

Waves are the significant wave height - the average of the highest 
1/3 of the wave spectrum. Occasional wave height is the average of 
the highest 1/10 of the wave spectrum.

LSZ140-110400-
Grand Portage to Grand Marais MN-
211 PM CDT Sat Oct 10 2026

.TONIGHT...Southwest wind 15 to 20 knots with gusts to around
25 knots. Mostly clear. Waves 3 to 5 feet. Waves occasionally to
7 feet. 
.SUNDAY...Southwest wind 10 to 15 knots with gusts to around
20 knots becoming northwest 5 to 10 knots late in the afternoon.
Mostly sunny. Waves 3 to 5 feet subsiding to 1 to 2 feet late in
the afternoon. A small craft advisory may be needed. 
.SUNDAY NIGHT...Northeast wind 20 to 25 knots with gusts to
around 30 knots. Slight chance of rain showers in the evening,
then chance of rain showers after midnight. Waves 1 to 2 feet
building to 4 to 6 feet in the late evening and overnight. Waves
occasionally to 7 feet. A small craft advisory may be needed. 
.MONDAY...Northeast wind 20 to 25 knots. Gusts up to 35 knots
decreasing to 30 knots late in the afternoon. Rain showers likely
in the morning, then slight chance of rain showers in the
afternoon. Waves 4 to 6 feet. Waves occasionally to 8 feet. A
gale warning may be needed.
